change_summary: Repair of the transfer failures observed in external held-out run 33293694601. Four localized changes, all additive or tightening, none removing or re-scoping any rule. Section 5.9 gains the procedure for recognising which declared identifier is the registered comparison as a whole -- the one genuine knowledge gap, since v1.0 required that identifier by name but never taught how to find it, and the evaluator's own generator always named it literally `experiment`. Section 6.3 gains the action-grounds couplings that v1.0 already asserts in sections 4, 5.3, 5.7 and 5.9 but never gathered where the assembled result is checked. Section 6.3 names the scale_readiness nesting violation. Section 6.1 constrains prose-field length. No new professional rule is introduced except the recognition procedure.
